module: Auxiliary "speed governor" controller of a combustion engine (the file name contains the typo "Govenor"). A PID computes a throttle command so that the engine speed follows a target that varies linearly from rpmTarget0 to rpmTarget1 according to the throttle input; the command is published in electrics.values.throttleGoverned (or jbeam name).
notes: jbeam keys read: controlledEngineName ("mainEngine"), rpmPIDp (0.5), rpmPIDi (0.1), rpmPIDd (0.05), rpmTarget0 (engine idle), rpmTarget1 (engine max RPM), throttleCommandElectricsName ("throttleGoverned"), throttleInputElectricsName ("throttle").
A missing engine leaves M.updateFixedStep at nil (log E "throttleGovenor").
updateFixedStep is nil at declaration and only assigned after a successful init.
The controller only writes the command electrics value: it is up to another element (jbeam/electrics) to use it to drive the engine.

updateFixedStep.desc: PID loop, assigned in init if the engine is found.

init.desc: Gets the engine, creates the PID, computes the angular speed targets and the electrics names.

reset.desc: Resets the PID if the engine exists.
